items.title: Formally verified polygon intersection – Opus 4.8 oneshots, prev failed
items.raw_excerpt: To my knowledge, this is the first formally verified implementation of an intersection algorithm for polygons. The experience of working with AI agents on this project changed a lot with recent model releases, as I describe in the readme. Opus 4.8 is able to provide algorithm implementation with formal proof in one shot, whereas previous models required me to provide proof strategies in multiple steps. Trust in the correctness comes entirely from the Lean checker and human review of a small specification, not from the LLM. Also check out the web demo built around the verified core linked in the readme: https://schildep.github.io/verified-polygon-intersection/ . It supports multipolygons including holes, self intersections, and overlapping edges.

title_i18n.en: Formally verified polygon intersection – Opus 4.8 oneshots, prev failed

items.title: 中科闻歌发布 Decitron 决策机：跳出问答大模型，AI 迈入真实世界推演时代
items.raw_excerpt: 决策机Decitron发布会现场 2026年6月5日，中科闻歌正式发布通用决策大模型——Decitron决策机。作为面向复杂事件、复杂系统和复杂决策打造的产品，Decitron决策机不只是回答问题，而是理解事件、推演路径、比较结果，帮助人类在复杂事务中做决策。 “AI已经开始像水和电一样进入现实世界和人们的生活。但当AI会聊天、会写作、会画画、会做视频之后，一个更重要的问题正在出现：AI能不能不只是回答问题，而是进一步推演世界、预测未来？”发布会上，中科闻歌董事长王磊抛出了这个关于AI下一阶段发展的关键问题。 正是基于对这一问题的思考，中科闻歌正式发布了AI决策时代的全新产品——Decitron决策机。王磊表示：它不是聊天机器人或者搜索引擎，而是一个能够分析事件关联、模拟不同选择、推演可能未来的通用决策大模型。Decitron决策机的使命，是“推演世界、看见未来”。 不止回答问题，更要推演路径 作为面向通用决策场景打造的决策智能模型产品，Decitron决策机并不局限于单一行业或单一任务，它聚焦存在不确定性、多路径选择和多方博弈的复杂决策问题，可广泛应用于金融市场、宏观经济、国际形势、公共治理、企业战略、投资研究和产业研判等领域。 为了更直观展示这一能力，发布会现场，中科闻歌以“美联储主席更替后，2026年美国利率政策可能如何演化”这一宏观金融政策情景为例，完整演示了Decitron决策机的推演流程，并展示其与传统AI问答的不同。 这一问题看似是一个宏观财经判断，普通AI更多回答“是什么”，但在Decitron决策机的处理逻辑中，它将详细推演“会怎样、怎么办”。系统会将问题拆解为：在什么条件下可能发生、何时可能发生、可能发生到什么程度；如果没有发生，又是哪些变量改变了事件原有路径。 演示显示，用户输入问题后，Decitron决策机并不会立即给出结论，它首先会判断问题是否具备

excerpt_i18n.es: Presentación del Decitron, el modelo de decisión. El 5 de junio de 2026, Zhongke Wenge lanzó oficialmente el modelo general de decisión —Decitron. Diseñado para eventos complejos, sistemas complejos y toma de decisiones complejas, Decitron no solo responde preguntas, sino que comprende eventos, deduce trayectorias y compara resultados, ayudando a los humanos a tomar decisiones en asuntos complejos. «La IA ya está empezando a entrar en el mundo real y en la vida de las personas como el agua y la electricidad. Pero después de que la IA pueda conversar, escribir, dibujar y hacer videos, surge una cuestión aún más importante: ¿puede la IA no solo responder preguntas, sino también deducir el mundo y predecir el futuro?».
excerpt_i18n.en:
Decitron Launch Event  
On June 5, 2026, Zhongke Wenge officially launched its general-purpose decision-making large model—Decitron. Designed for complex events, complex systems, and complex decision-making, Decitron goes beyond answering questions; it understands events, simulates pathways, and compares outcomes to assist humans in making decisions in complex matters.  

"AI has begun to permeate the real world and people's lives, much like water and electricity. But after AI can chat, write, draw, and create videos, a more important question emerges: Can AI not only answer questions but also simulate the world and predict the future?" At the launch event, Wang Lei, Chairman of Zhongke Wenge, posed this critical question about the next stage of AI development.  

Driven by this question, Zhongke Wenge officially unveiled its new product for the AI decision-making era—Decitron. Wang Lei stated: "It is not a chatbot or a search engine, but a general-purpose decision-making large model capable of analyzing event correlations, simulating different choices, and predicting possible futures." Decitron's mission is to "simulate the world and see the future."  

Beyond Answering Questions, Simulating Pathways  
As a decision intelligence model product designed for general decision-making scenarios, Decitron is not limited to a single industry or task. It focuses on complex decision-making problems involving uncertainty, multiple pathways, and multi-party interactions, and can be widely applied in financial markets, macroeconomics, international affairs, and more.

items.title: 独家解读丨时隔五年，OpenAI为何非要吃机器人这口「回头草」？
items.raw_excerpt: 时隔五年，山姆·奥特曼为何重返机器人？这是他在X上官宣这则消息后，业内最大的疑问。 是担心股价破发，开始拼命画饼讲故事了？还是Anthropic万亿估值压顶下，OpenAI不得不寻求更大差异化？亦或是说，物理世界的 AGI 临界点真的已到来？ 聚光灯正在移位。2026年的AI科技舞台上，OpenAI 早已告别了独占鳌头的绝对主角时代。 随着马斯克SpaceX、OpenAI、Anthropic 三家超级巨头相继步入美股 IPO 的敲钟倒计时，一场残酷的估值绞杀战已然打响。 SpaceX已突破1.75万亿美元，Anthropic估值也已超过OpenAI，以9650亿距万亿一步之遥， 这也让卡在两大巨头夹缝之间的OpenAI的处境变得前所未有的尴尬。 在这一敏感节点，奥特曼选择重新捡起当年亲手砍掉的机器人业务，究竟在赌什么？ 01 是“股价叙事”还是竞争所迫？ “为什么重返机器人？因为容易融资。”某国内头部AI Lab研究员周立明对雷峰网表示。 在她看来，OpenAI马上要上市了，但Agent和大语言模型的蛋糕分得差不多了， OpenAI继续讲大模型和Agent是拼不过谷歌和Anthropic的，它需要讲机器人，否则有可能破发。 “虽然机器人行业现在日子也不好过，一直不太落地，但架不住总有钱源源不断地往这个领域流，就眼下来说，机器人还是最吸金的话题之一。” 事实上，自今年上半年Anthropic的ARR开始陡峭增长、季度营收和估值双双反超OpenAI起，OpenAI股价破发的观点就开始流传于华尔街。毕竟，不同于2022年底一骑绝尘的势头，眼下的OpenAI面临不小的友商压力。 在自变量机器人创始人王潜看来，OpenAI重返机器人业务，一方面 Open AI 一直将物理智能视为AGI不可或缺的一环，另一方面的核心的驱动力是： 与Anthropic的激烈竞争促使它不得不寻求更多差异化

excerpt_i18n.zh: 时隔五年，山姆·奥特曼为何重返机器人？这是他在X上官宣这则消息后，业内最大的疑问。 是担心股价破发，开始拼命画饼讲故事了？还是Anthropic万亿估值压顶下，OpenAI不得不寻求更大差异化？亦或是说，物理世界的 AGI 临界点真的已到来？ 聚光灯正在移位。2026年的AI科技舞台上，OpenAI 早已告别了独占鳌头的绝对主角时代。 随着马斯克SpaceX、OpenAI、Anthropic 三家超级巨头相继步入美股 IPO 的敲钟倒计时，一场残酷的估值绞杀战已然打响。 SpaceX已突破1.75万亿美元，Anthropic估值也已超过OpenAI，以9650亿距万亿一步之遥， 这也让卡在两大巨头夹缝之间的OpenAI的处境变得前所未有的尴尬。 在这一敏感节点，奥特曼选择重新捡起当年亲手砍掉的机器人业务，究竟在赌什么？ 01 是“股价叙事”还是竞争所迫？ “为什么重返机器人？因为容易融资。”某国内头部AI Lab研究员周立明对雷峰网表示。 在她看来，OpenAI马上要上市了，但Agent和大语言模型的蛋糕分得差不多了， OpenAI继续讲大模型和Agent是拼不过谷歌和Anthropic的，它需要讲机器人，否则有可能破发。 “虽然机器人行业现在日子也不好过，一直不太落地，但架不住总有钱源源不断地往这个领域流，就眼下来说，机器人还是最吸金的话题之一。” 事实上，自今年上半年Anthropic的ARR开始陡峭增长、季度营收和估值双双反超OpenAI起，OpenAI股价破发的观点就开始流传于华尔街。毕竟，不同于2022年底一骑绝尘的势头，眼下的OpenAI面临不小的友商压力。 在自变量机器人创始人王潜看来，OpenAI重返机器人业务，一方面 Open AI 一直将物理智能视为AGI不可或缺的一环，另一方面的核心的驱动力是： 与Anthropic的激烈竞争促使它不得不寻求更多差异化
excerpt_i18n.en: After five years, why is Sam Altman returning to robotics? This is the biggest question in the industry after his announcement on X. Is he worried about a stock price drop and starting to spin stories? Or is OpenAI forced to seek greater differentiation under Anthropic's trillion-dollar valuation pressure? Or has the AGI tipping point in the physical world truly arrived? The spotlight is shifting. On the AI technology stage of 2026, OpenAI has long left the era of absolute dominance. As SpaceX, OpenAI, and Anthropic—three supergiants—enter the countdown to their U.S. stock IPOs, a brutal valuation war has begun. SpaceX has surpassed $1.75 trillion, and Anthropic's valuation has exceeded OpenAI's, standing at $965 billion, just one step away from a trillion. This puts OpenAI, caught between the two giants, in an unprecedented awkward position. At this sensitive juncture, what is Altman betting on by reviving the robotics business he once cut? 01 Is it a "stock narrative" or competitive pressure? "Why return to robotics? Because it's easy to raise funds," said Zhou Liming, a researcher at a top domestic AI lab, to Leiphone. In her view, OpenAI is about to go public, but the pie of agents and large language models has been largely divided. OpenAI cannot compete with Google and Anthropic by continuing to focus on large models and agents.
excerpt_i18n.es: Cinco años después, ¿por qué Sam Altman regresa a la robótica? Esa es la mayor duda en la industria tras su anuncio oficial en X. ¿Acaso teme que el precio de las acciones caiga por debajo del de salida a bolsa y recurre a promesas vacías para mantener el interés? ¿O es que, bajo la presión de la valoración de un billón de dólares de Anthropic, OpenAI se ve obligada a buscar una mayor diferenciación? ¿O acaso el punto de inflexión de la AGI en el mundo físico realmente ha llegado? El foco está cambiando. En el escenario tecnológico de la IA en 2026, OpenAI ya no es el protagonista absoluto que dominaba la escena. Con SpaceX de Musk, OpenAI y Anthropic —tres gigantes— entrando en la cuenta atrás para su salida a bolsa en EE. UU.

excerpt_i18n.en: On June 1, Gartner Research Vice President Gao Ting delivered a specialized industry sharing session on the development prospects of the global robotics industry in 2026, with Leiphone.com participating. Gao Ting cautioned enterprises in manufacturing, services, and other sectors to avoid the misconception of blindly following trends in procuring humanoid robots, and instead adhere to an implementation approach that first identifies application scenarios and then selects models based on specific needs. From a macro-industrial perspective, the World Economic Forum predicts that by 2030, the global manufacturing labor gap will exceed 10 million, with accelerating global aging and declining birthrates driving the rigid demand for robots. excerpt_i18n.en: The Canadian government officially unveiled a new national AI strategy called "AI for All" on the 4th. The strategy plans to invest billions of Canadian dollars in public funds, accelerating the construction of a domestic AI industry system and comprehensively promoting technology adoption and sovereign security through core measures such as establishing a technology growth fund, expanding sovereign computing infrastructure, and strengthening legal regulation. One of the core measures of the new strategy is the establishment of the "Canadian Tech Growth Fund" worth 500 million Canadian dollars (approximately 360 million US dollars). The fund aims to fill the scaling capital gap faced by high-growth domestic AI enterprises. (Sina Finance)
excerpt_i18n.es: El gobierno de Canadá publicó oficialmente el 4 de abril su nueva estrategia nacional de inteligencia artificial, denominada "IA para Todos" (AI for All). La estrategia prevé invertir miles de millones de dólares canadienses en fondos públicos, acelerando la construcción de un sistema industrial local de inteligencia artificial mediante medidas clave como la creación de un fondo de crecimiento tecnológico, la expansión de la infraestructura informática soberana y el fortalecimiento de la regulación legal, impulsando de manera integral la difusión tecnológica y la seguridad soberana. Una de las medidas centrales de la nueva estrategia es la creación del "Fondo Canadiense de Crecimiento Tecnológico" (Canadian Tech Growth Fund), con un capital de 500 millones de dólares canadienses (aproximadamente 360 millones de dólares estadounidenses). Este fondo tiene como objetivo cubrir las necesidades de capital a gran escala que enfrentan las empresas locales de IA de alto crecimiento.

items.title: 他用WPS笔记，把AI报错变成了可复用的“避坑指南”
items.raw_excerpt: “AI Coding 最大的风险不是写不出代码，而是忘记了自己为什么做出某个判断。” 这不是一句抽象判断，而是工程师曹健在反复处理 AI 报错后得到的真实体会。6月5日，在金山办公旗下「WPS AI Next」活动现场，他从自己的 AI Coding 工作流讲起，分享了使用 WPS 笔记沉淀技术经验的故事。 当天发布的 WPS 笔记，是一款面向个人知识管理场景的 AI 原生多模态笔记产品，主张“随心记录，轻松有序”。对曹健来说，这句话并不抽象。它对应的是一次半夜两点的报错、一套 47 万字的资料库，以及一次从 30 分钟到 3 分钟的排查效率变化。 那次GPU飙到100%后，他多年的积累没能帮到他 2025年的某天凌晨两点，曹健的笔记本电脑GPU占用率飙到100%，屏幕彻底卡死。他自己部署的语音模型，因为一个AI报错整晚停摆，而比这更让他崩溃的是，他隐约记得自己解决过类似的问题，但不记得那条解决记录被放在了哪里。 作为一家外企的技术支持人员，曹健平时既要跟踪用户反馈，又要记录软件更新，还要跑AI辅助写代码。他积累了一个47万字的文档资料库，但那个凌晨，多年的资料并没有帮他定位问题。 此前，他试过市面上几乎所有笔记工具，但复杂的产品设计常常让他望而却步。“打开就得做规划、选知识库、找位置、建分类，然后才是生成文档，像是要让你写本书”，曹健说，繁复的设置和交互摩擦，总让他有卸载的冲动。 一次偶然的机会，他在小红书刷到了WPS笔记内测招募的帖子。获得内测资格后，他打开产品界面，发现屏幕中间只有两个按钮。“当时我愣了一下，”他回忆道，“产品做得‘很轻’，像是有人终于想明白了怎么记笔记这件事。” “同类AI报错排查从30分钟降到了3分钟” 曹健每天要处理海量信息，但不是所有内容都得单独建一篇文档。“大多时候，我只想先把它们放在某个地方，再集中整理。” WPS笔记刚好对上了他的需求。“

excerpt_i18n.en: In the first half of this year, external observers often had a vague sense of Huawei Cloud's AI strategy. Over the past six months, cloud vendors' AI narratives have become increasingly specific: Alibaba Cloud and Volcano Engine are both emphasizing model call volumes and MaaS revenue, while Tencent Cloud is currently focusing on blockbuster applications. In contrast, where Huawei Cloud intends to position itself at the core in the AI era has not always been clear to outsiders. This time, the Huawei Cloud INSPIRE Conference provided a good window for observation. From this conference, Huawei Cloud is articulating its position more clearly: downward, it aims to be the "silicon-based black soil" of the intelligent agent era; upward, it seeks to find outlets for AI commercialization in industry scenarios such as healthcare, embodied intelligence, manufacturing, and scientific research. Huawei Cloud does not want to be defined solely by MaaS. During a media group interview at the event, Leiphone.com posed a direct question to Huawei Cloud's CEO: In the first half of this year, Alibaba Cloud and Volcano Engine have been pushing for MaaS revenue. How does Huawei Cloud view MaaS revenue? And does it have specific revenue targets for this year? This question is actually quite critical. In the past general computing era, cloud vendors primarily focused on infrastructure revenue: CPU cores, storage, bandwidth, and resource consumption. Now, in the intelligent computing era, the industry is entering a token economy, where MaaS revenue, model call volumes, and token consumption are becoming new metrics for measuring AI cloud. However, Zhou Yuefeng's response was also straightforward. He stated that Huawei Cloud does not deny the token economy, but it cannot simply be measured by "how many trillions of tokens."
excerpt_i18n.es: En la primera mitad de este año, la estrategia de Huawei Cloud en IA a menudo parecía difusa para el exterior. En los últimos seis meses, la narrativa de IA de los proveedores de nube se ha vuelto cada vez más concreta: Alibaba Cloud y Volcano Engine hablan de volúmenes de invocación de modelos e ingresos de MaaS, mientras que Tencent Cloud se centra en aplicaciones populares. En contraste, el exterior no siempre tenía claro cuál sería la posición central de Huawei Cloud en la era de la IA. Esta vez, la conferencia Huawei Cloud INSPIRE ha proporcionado una buena ventana de observación. Desde esta conferencia, Huawei Cloud está definiendo más claramente su posición: hacia abajo, busca ser la "tierra negra de silicio" en la era de los agentes inteligentes; hacia arriba, desde la medicina hasta la robótica.
